Banner.Description: With over 10 years of experience in web design and development, I have honed my skills in structure, functionality, configuration, testing, delivery, and maintenance. My expertise extends to web application design, architecture, implementation, and integration. I am known for being a responsible, intelligent professional who is process-oriented, a fast learner, and a self-starter. I excel in problem-solving and stay updated with the latest technologies and standards. Possessing excellent communication skills, I work effectively both independently and as a productive team member, capable of taking on leadership and mentoring roles. My motivation and commitment to excellence make me a valuable asset in any professional setting.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: With 12+ years of professional experience in software development , I have successfully contributed in multiple roles such as System Analyst, Frontend Architect, Backend Developer, and Technical Leader. My expertise lies in building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance applications with a strong focus on frontend architecture, especially in Angular and modern web technologies .

I have a proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise-level applications , ensuring performance optimization, standardizing coding practices, and driving best-in-class UI/UX experiences. I consistently contribute to improving system efficiency, streamlining development processes, and introducing patterns that enhance scalability and maintainability.

Beyond development, I enjoy mentoring teams , fostering a culture of clean code, and driving technical discussions that shape project direction. My leadership approach combines empathy, collaboration, and clear goal-setting to empower teams and deliver high-quality outcomes. I’ve also actively led code reviews, architectural discussions, and CI/CD adoption to ensure long-term project success.

I have hands-on experience with unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices , ensuring robust delivery pipelines and high code coverage. On the backend, I’ve successfully contributed using ExpressJS, NestJS, MongoDB, and MySQL , making me comfortable in full-stack environments when needed.

My passion extends beyond professional projects—I frequently experiment with personal utilities and side projects to sharpen my skills, explore new frameworks, and stay aligned with industry best practices. I constantly keep myself updated with Angular’s evolving versions and ecosystem , leveraging RxJS, NgRx, and microfrontend strategies to build dynamic and resilient applications.

Some of the key areas of my expertise include
(but are not limited to): Frontend Architecture, Angular (1.x – 17+), TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, State Management, UI Frameworks, Design Systems, Performance Optimization, CI/CD, and Team Leadership .

OtherProjects.Title: More projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Sales & Purchase CRM
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In-house project aimed at enhancing current sales and procurement processes, integrating an e-commerce portal into a unified, easily accessible software solution. Implementing modular solutions using Angular 10, Bootstrap CSS framework, jQuery, JavaScript, custom CSS, and Flexbox for frontend development, with .NET Core and MongoDB for backend development. Enhanced CSV file import module includes filtering, search functionalities, and direct database integration. Adhered to existing application specifications for seamless integration of new features.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Car Leasing System:  Quote Management Application
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This project involved modernizing an application using Angular 10, Angular Material, Flex Module, Redux, RxJs, RxWeb-Angular, Web API, and Microservices. It automates the leasing process for employee vehicles.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Fleet Manager Utility App
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Upgrade Fleet Management App from V1 to V2, incorporating new features such as quote management, fleet management tools, driver and supplier modules, etc. The primary objective is to enhance and update existing functionalities while integrating additional features to expand support according to client specifications.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Sytner Digital Transformation: Dealer System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The primary objective is to create a responsive application that functions seamlessly across web and mobile platforms. The application enables users to utilize Google Maps to locate nearby garages, book appointments for car servicing, and communicate directly with the service providers. Users can select from a variety of services offered by the garage or service station and track the entire service process from start to finish. Additionally, users have the option to rent a car while their own vehicle is being serviced and make payments through the application.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Car Service Booking - OLB Front & Back Office
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: As the lead Front-End Developer, I played a key role in transforming a non-functional prototype (NFP) back office into a fully operational application. Using Angular and Bootstrap, I developed robust interfaces for the NFP, enhancing its usability and functionality. Additionally, I independently created a front office application that seamlessly integrated as a hybrid app within a client's website using iframes. The Back Office system consisted of several essential modules including Appointment Management, Service Catalog, Mechanic Management, Dealer Management, Brand and Model Catalogs, and Role and Site Administration. The Front Office application was designed as a user-friendly wizard process, consolidating data from all back office modules to streamline appointment bookings. This process included selecting services, brands, models, mechanics, and dealers, ensuring a cohesive and efficient user experience.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: UI Component Library
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In this project, our primary objective is to develop theme-based components tailored to meet tenant requirements. Based on Azure site configurations, we will implement necessary modifications to prepare tenant sites. Our focus is on creating reusable components that can be utilized across various contexts and support multilingual capabilities.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Clockwork Connect: Recruitment Application
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Recruitment application leveraging Progressive Web App (PWA) principles, developed in pure JavaScript and utilizing the Sammy.js framework for class-based routing. The application supports three primary user roles: staffing company, consultant, and candidate, each with tailored functionalities

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Salesforce : automation of Procurement, Repacking & Warehousing processes
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: AscentERP implemented a Salesforce-based application tailored for the procurement, repackaging, and warehousing processes of a prominent UK-based Pharmaceutical company, specializing in Europe-wide Parallel Imports.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Salesforce : Managing Campaigns, Hand Written Notes
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In this project, I focused on Salesforce Lightning component development. I utilized the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) library to convert standard Visualforce pages into Lightning-ready pages. This transition ensures seamless switching between Salesforce Classic and Lightning Experience, maintaining consistent user interface and functionality across platforms.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Backgammon - A Board Game
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This gaming project allows users to register and participate in multiplayer games where they can compete against both other users and AI-controlled robots. Players can enjoy gaming for entertainment or choose to play with real money, engaging in diverse levels of challenge and excitement.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Grooup Room - Project Mangement & Organization Collaborative App
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This project involves developing a versatile multitasking application that facilitates collaboration among users through features such as sharing, chatting, file sharing, and task assignment. The application will include distinct phases for different user roles: Patient, Doctor, and Admin.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Doctor Stay - Patient & Clinical System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In this project, we have developed a comprehensive Patient Management System with distinct phases for Patients, Doctors, and Admins. The system facilitates patients in booking appointments with registered doctors and allows doctors to manage patient profiles, digital prescriptions, and patient history. Additionally, the admin phase supports verification processes, subscription management, and application promotions.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: RecruitBazaar - Job Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In this project, we are developing a console application that facilitates the sending of bulk emails. The application features a function that captures email addresses and sends festival greetings from the master application settings. As an additional application or plugin, it enables sending emails to a list of users, including an Excel sheet attachment generated by the existing system. This project comprises three modules: company, consultant, and candidate. It includes features such as job posting, candidate hiring, MCQ tests, CV review, and interview scheduling. Access to these features is role-based. We use Angular for the front-end/presentation layer, and ASP.NET with a SQL Server for back-end support.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Custom CMS - Portfolio Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This project involves the development of two distinct websites: one for the company portal and another for the company's client portal. Additionally, we will create basic themes and logos for both the company and its clients. A cPanel will be provided for managing products, services, and other details to be showcased digitally.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Report Board - Report Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This web application communicates with a server-stored database to generate comprehensive reports. The system includes the following modules: Query Builder: Allows users to create custom database queries. Report Generation: Provides reports in an HTML view. Export Functionality: Supports exporting reports to Excel and PDF formats.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Email Plug
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: In this project, we are developing a console application that has the functionality to send bulk emails based on a function that captures email addresses. Additionally, it is utilized to send festival greetings from the master application settings. As an add-on application or plugin, it helps to send emails to a list of users with an attachment of an Excel sheet generated by the existing system.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Leave Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The system enables employees to create leave requests and submit them to relevant authorities, including the HR Manager, Project Manager, Department Head, and Team Leader. The platform allows designated approvers to either approve or reject leave requests. If a request receives the majority of approvals, the leave is sanctioned. Conversely, if the majority rejects the request, it is canceled.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Lab Management System - Soil & Material Test & Report Management
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The system facilitates the calculation of observation values and conclusions from material tests conducted by the machine. It also generates testing reports for both builders and company records. Based on the client's testing equations, test values are stored in a database. Multiple tests can be conducted on the same material to ensure optimal results.
